title: 第十七章 好好活着你不愿第十八章 第一刀
content_zh:
狄九心满意足的收起了手中的木刀，浑身上下充满了一种澎湃。就好像有一道滚烫的气息在身体之中流动，这种气息给他带来了强壮和力量。狄九知道，他已经步入了武者初期的行列。
狄家的武学是动中修炼的，来潭杏堂才六天时间，狄氏七刀的第一刀他就已经入门。第一刀入门，也就是武者初期。
这种修炼速度，纵观狄氏家族的历史，也找不出来第二个。
根据狄九的记忆，狄氏资质最优秀的弟子，修炼狄氏七刀第一刀入门也需要三个月时间。而他，只是用了六天。而且这六天，他还没有师父教。
而且他用的药材还是比较差的，购买的人参和雪莲子年份都不足，还有几样甚至是人工培植的。要知道济国狄氏富贵，门下就算是旁系子弟也不会用这种垃圾药材的。
这还是沈梓语给了一张银行卡给他，这些药材购买回来，那银行卡里面的三十多万也都用完了。
狄九用手摸了摸挂在胸口的灰色石头，心里很是感激这枚灰色石头。他之所以练武资质变得如此强大，都是因为这枚灰色石头。不仅仅如此，就连他的理解能力和记忆也变得强悍的可怕。
以前他的理解能力也很强，绝对达不到这种程度。
唯一遗憾的是，他没有一柄好刀，这柄木刀还是他找了一根较重的木材，自己削出来的。
狄氏七刀学会第三刀才会从武者跨入武士，学会第五刀，就从武士迈入武师。能施展第六刀，那就意味着是一个大武师，而第七刀，那就等于跨入了武王层次。
狄氏有史以来，只有狄家老祖狄跃练成了第七刀，跨入了武王层次。
狄九收起了刀，他知道自己练成第一刀后，就必须要再寻找一些更好的滋补药材服用。狄氏七刀对身体强度要求很高，如果不及时用滋补药材弥补修炼过程中的伤害，将来不但无法跨入更高的层次，甚至可能落下极大的后遗症，这是每一个狄氏弟子都必须要知道的。
沈梓语给他的钱用完了，那张洛大武学系报名资格又送给了游狐离，他要来钱，只能另外想办法。
“嘭嘭嘭！”外面一阵阵敲门的声音传来，狄九疑惑的放下手中的木刀，走出了后院。
在这里六天时间，除了胡哥来了一次外，不要说病人，就连一只小猫也没有进过这里。
就是胡哥来这里，也是中午的时候。所以狄九一般都是早上四点起来，练武到十点开门。开门后，就是不练武，狄九也是在研究狄氏七刀。到下午四点就关门，练武到十点。
现在才五点左右，就有人来敲门，还是第一遭。
门被打开，站在门口的是一名三十岁左右的女人，女人背上还背着一名差不多年龄的男子。
女人头发有些凌乱，几缕发丝贴在脸上还带着一些清晨的露水。这女人长得还很清秀，从她带着汗水的脸上可以看出，她应该是一路将这男子背过来的。
将一个壮年男子背来，无论这女人背了多远，可见这女人的力量不小。

不对，有淡淡的血腥气息。狄九眼光往下就看见了血已染红了女人的背部，甚至渗透到了长裤上。
男子脸色苍白，应该是重伤。
“医生求你帮忙救救他……”女人没有在意狄九的目光，语气中带着一丝恳求。
“这里现在没有医生，你应该去医院啊……”
狄九的话还没说完，女人就不断恳求的说道，“求求你，求求你救他，再不救他，就不行了……”
不用这女人说，狄九也能看出来女人背后的男子应该是快不行了，他失血实在是太多。
content_en:
Di Jiu put away the wooden knife in his hand with satisfaction, and his whole body was filled with excitement. It was as if there was a hot breath flowing through his body, and this breath brought him strength and strength. Di Jiu knew that he had entered the ranks of early warriors.
The Di family's martial arts is practiced in Dongzhong. He has only been in Tanxing Hall for six days, and he has already mastered the first of Di's seven swords. The first sword entry is the early stage of a warrior.
Looking at the history of the Di family, there is no other such speed in cultivation.
According to Di Jiu's memory, it would take three months for Di's most qualified disciple to master the first of Di's seven swords. But he only spent six days. Moreover, he has not had a master to teach him these six days.
Moreover, the medicinal materials he used were relatively poor. The ginseng and snow lotus seeds he purchased were not old enough, and some of them were even artificially cultivated. You must know that the Di family in Jiguo is rich and noble, and even the descendants of the family will not use such rubbish medicinal materials.
Shen Ziyu gave him a bank card. After purchasing these medicinal materials, all the more than 300,000 yuan in the bank card was used up.
Di Jiu touched the gray stone hanging on his chest with his hand, feeling very grateful for this gray stone. The reason why his martial arts qualifications have become so strong is because of this gray stone. Not only that, even his understanding and memory have become frighteningly powerful.
His understanding ability was also very strong before, but he could never reach this level.
The only regret was that he didn't have a good knife. He found a piece of heavier wood and cut it out by himself.
Only when you learn the third sword of Di's Seven Swords will you step from a warrior to a warrior. After learning the fifth sword, will you step from a warrior to a martial artist. Being able to use the sixth sword means that you are a great martial artist, and the seventh sword means that you have entered the level of the King of Martial Arts.
In the history of the Di family, only Di Yue, the ancestor of the Di family, had mastered the seventh sword and entered the level of King Wu.
Di Jiu put away the knife. He knew that after he mastered the first knife, he would have to find some better nourishing herbs. Di's Seven Swordsmanship requires very high physical strength. If no nourishing medicinal materials are used to make up for the damage during the practice in time, not only will it be impossible to reach a higher level in the future, but it may even suffer serious sequelae. This is something every Di's disciple must know.
The money Shen Ziyu gave him ran out, and the registration qualification for Luo University's martial arts department was given to You Huli. He had to find another way to get the money.
"Bang bang bang!" There were knocks on the door outside. Di Jiu put down the wooden knife in his hand in confusion and walked out of the backyard.
In the six days here, except for Brother Hu's visit once, not to mention the patients, not even a kitten came in here.
Even Brother Hu came here at noon. So Di Jiu usually gets up at four in the morning and practices martial arts until the door opens at ten. After opening the door, even if he wasn't practicing martial arts, Di Jiu was studying Di's Seven Swordsmen. It closes at four o'clock in the afternoon, and martial arts practice lasts until ten o'clock.
It was only around five o'clock when someone knocked on the door. This was the first time.
The door was opened, and standing at the door was a woman of about thirty years old. The woman was carrying a man of about the same age on her back.
The woman's hair was a little messy, and a few strands of hair stuck to her face with some morning dew. This woman was very pretty, and it could be seen from her sweaty face that she must have carried the man on her back all the way.
When a strong man is carried on his back, no matter how far the woman is carried, it shows that the woman is quite powerful.
No, there is a faint smell of blood. Di Jiu glanced down and saw that the blood had stained the woman's back and even seeped into her trousers.
The man's face was pale and he must have been seriously injured.
"Doctor, please help save him..." The woman didn't pay attention to Di Jiu's gaze, with a hint of pleading in her tone.
"There is no doctor here now, you should go to the hospital..."
Before Di Jiu finished speaking, the woman kept pleadingHe said pleadingly, "Please, please save him. If you don't save him, it won't work..."
Without the woman's words, Di Jiu could tell that the man behind the woman was dying. He had lost too much blood.
